content: Abudonin biru Isirelibɑ bɑ kpɑm kuɑ ye yɑǹ Yinni Gusunɔ dore, mɑ u bu Filisitibɑ nɔmu bɛriɑ wɔ̃ɔ weeru.
N deemɑ durɔ ɡoo wɑ̃ɑ Soreɑɔ Dɑnun bweseru sɔɔ, win yĩsirɑ Mɑnɔɑ. Win kurɔ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ wĩro.
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo

ɡoo u kurɔ wi kure u nɛɛ, wee, ɑ sɑ̃ɑ wĩro, ɑdɑmɑ kɑɑ ɡurɑ suɑ kpɑ ɑ bii tɔn durɔ mɑ. U ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ wi bɑ wunɑ nɛnɛm Gusunɔn sɔ̃ sɑɑ win mɑrubun di. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ n tii sɛ, ɑ ku tɑm ɡɑm nɔ, kpɑ ɑ ku ɡɑ̃ɑ seseruɡinu di. A ku rɑ mɑɑ de bu bii win seri burɑ, domi wiyɑ u koo Isirelibɑ wɔrɑm tore sɑɑ Filisitibɑn nɔmɑn di.
Mɑ kurɔ wi, u dɑ u win durɔ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔn tɔnu ɡoowɑ u mɑn deemɑ. U sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo ɡoo. U nɑnum mɔ too. Nɑǹ mɑɑ nùn bikie mìn di u nɑ. Uǹ mɑɑ mɑn win yĩsiru sɔ̃ɔwɑ.

Adɑmɑ u mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kon be ɡurɑ suɑ kpɑ n bii tɔn durɔ mɑ. Yen sɔ̃, n ku be tɑm ɡɑm nɔ, kpɑ n ku ɡɑ̃ɑ seseruɡinu di. Domi bii wi, u ko n sɑ̃ɑ wi bɑ wunɑ nɛnɛm Gusunɔn sɔ̃ sɑɑ win mɑrubun di sere kɑ win wɑ̃ɑrun nɔrɔ.
Yerɑ Mɑnɔɑ u kɑnɑru kuɑ nɡe mɛni, u nɛɛ, Yinni, ɑ de wunɛn tɔnu wi ɑ ɡɔrimɑ mi, u kpɑm sun nɑɑwɑ kpɑ u sun sɔ̃ɔsi ye n weenɛ su bii wi kuɑ wi sɑ ko mɑ mi.
Mɑ Gusunɔ u Mɑnɔɑn kɑnɑru mwɑ, u derɑ win ɡɔrɑdo wi, u wurɑ kurɔ win mi, mi u sɔ̃ ɡberɔ. Adɑmɑ win durɔ sɑri mi.
Mɑ u dukɑ dɑ win durɔn mi, u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, durɔ wi u nɑ nɛn mi ɡin teeru, wee u mɑɑ nɑ tɛ̃.
Mɑnɔɑ u seewɑ u win kurɔ swĩi bɑ nɑ durɔ win mi. Yerɑ Mɑnɔɑ nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, wunɑ ɑ kɑ kurɔ wi ɡɑri kuɑ? Mɑ u nɛɛ, oo, nɛnɑ.
Mɑnɔɑ u nɛɛ, wunɛn ɡɑri yi, yì n koorɑ, woodɑ yerɑ̀ sɑ ko swĩi bii win sɔ̃. Amɔnɑ sɑ ko nùn kuɑ.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo wi, u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ye nɑ kurɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ mi kpuro, yerɑ u koo se.
Uǹ koo ɡɑ̃ɑnu di ni nu yɑrɑ resɛm di. Uǹ tɑm ɡɑm nɔrumɔ, uǹ mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ seseruɡinu dimɔ. Ye nɑ nùn yiire mi kpuro, yerɑ u koo ko.
Mɑnɔɑ u Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ nun kɑnɑmɔ, ɑ de su nun ɡɔ̃rɑsiɑ, kpɑ su nun boo kpɛmu yɑɑrɛ ko.

Mɑ ɡɔrɑdo wi, u nɛɛ, bɑɑ ɑ̀ n mɑn ɡɔ̃rɑsiɑ, nɑǹ wunɛn dĩɑnu dimɔ. Adɑmɑ ɑ̀ n kĩ ɑ nu kon nɑ kɑ mɛ, ɑ kɑ ye Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡiru kuo. Mɑnɔɑ uǹ yɛ̃ mɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdowɑ durɔ wi, u sɑ̃ɑ.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ wunɛn yĩsiru, kpɑ su wɑ su nun tɑkɑru ko, wunɛn ɡɑri yi, yì n koorɑ.
Yerɑ ɡɔrɑdo wi, u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ nɛn yĩsiru bikiɑmɔ. Nɛn yĩsirɑ, wi u rɑ mɑɑmɑɑki ko.
Sɑɑ yerɑ Mɑnɔɑ u boo kpɛmu suɑ kɑ dĩɑnu ɡɑnu u yi kperu wɔllɔ u kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ yɑ̃kuru kuɑ, wi, wi u rɑ mɑɑmɑɑki ko. Sɑɑ ye Mɑnɔɑ kɑ win kurɔ bɑ yɑ̃ku te mɛɛrɑ,
sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ dɔ̃ɔ yɑrɑ yɑ seewɑ wɔllɔ yɑ̃ku ten min di, mɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo wi, u duɑ dɔ̃ɔ yɑrɑ ye sɔɔ u kɑ suɑrɑ. Ye Mɑnɔɑ kɑ win kurɔ bɑ wɑ mɛ, mɑ bɑ kpunɑ bɑ wuswɑɑ tem ɡirɑri.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ u den ɡiɑ mɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdowɑ mi. Sɑɑ dɔmɑ ten di Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo wi, uǹ mɑɑ nɑɑre ben mi.
Mɑ Mɑnɔɑ u win kurɔ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sɑ ko ɡbiwɑ mi, domi sɑ Gusunɔ wɑ.
Yerɑ win kurɔ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ ù n kĩ u sun ɡon nɑ, uǹ koo rɑɑ bɛsɛn yɑ̃ku te mwɑ. Uǹ koo rɑɑ mɑɑ de su yenibɑ kpuro wɑ kpɑ su yenin bweseru nɔ ye sɑ nuɑ tɛ̃.
Amɛn biru kurɔ wi, u ɡurɑ suɑ mɑ u bii tɔn durɔ mɑrɑ. Mɑ bɑ nùn yĩsiru kɑ̃ Sɑnsom. Bii wi, u kpɛ̃ɑ mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn domɑru kuɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u wɑ̃ɑ Mɑkɑnɛ Dɑnuɔ, Soreɑ kɑ Ɛsitɑolin bɑɑ sɔɔ, Yinni Gusunɔn Hunde u nùn yɔɔwɑ u kɑ win sɔmburu tore.
Sɑnsom u wɔndiɑ ɡoo kĩ
Tinnɑɔ
